name: Reykjavik, Iceland
description: Known for dramatic volcanic landscapes, natural geothermal hot springs, and stunning displays of the Northern Lights.

name: Banff National Park, Canada
description: Famous for its vibrant turquoise glacial lakes, towering Rocky Mountain peaks, and abundant wildlife.

name: Cape Town, South Africa
description: Renowned for its dramatic coastline, iconic Table Mountain, and nearby historic vineyards.

name: Venice, Italy
description: A unique city built on over 100 small islands in a lagoon, famous for its winding canals, gondolas, and Gothic architecture.

name: Petra, Jordan
description: An ancient archaeological city carved directly into vibrant pink sandstone cliffs, famous for its Treasury building.

name: Serengeti National Park, Tanzania
description: Famous for vast golden savannah plains and the annual Great Migration of millions of wildebeests and zebras.

name: Dubrovnik, Croatia
description: Known for its massive 16th-century stone walls encircling a charming, red-roofed Old Town along the Adriatic Sea.

name: Siem Reap, Cambodia
description: Gateway to the world's largest religious monument, Angkor Wat, featuring ancient stone temples intertwined with tree roots.

name: Fiordland National Park, New Zealand
description: Famous for deep glacier-carved fjords, towering waterfalls, and lush rainforests, including the famous Milford Sound.

name: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
description: Famous for its bustling Copacabana beach, dramatic coastal mountains, and the iconic Christ the Redeemer statue.
